EXT.evidence: He enthusiastically tells a group of friends about his first date and boasts it was one of the greatest ever, showing talkative, outgoing energy.

AGR.evidence: He is boastful about the date, plans to conceal his feelings and not call yet, and calls a friend “insane,” indicating less straightforwardness and lower warmth.

CON.evidence: He deliberately plans not to call the day after to avoid seeming needy and insists he’s right about this timing, showing controlled, planned behavior.

NEU.evidence: He worries about appearing needy and shapes his actions around that concern, reflecting sensitivity to social evaluation.

OPN.evidence: He follows a cautious, rule-bound dating script (withholding feelings and delaying contact) rather than being open or spontaneous.
